summary: Fixture manifest for the ADR-0034 lane G1 google set_attribute golden cases — mirrors the azurerm verify-lane fixture shapes (testdata/manifests-azure/compute.json): a scalar target.attr resize (google_compute_instance.machine_type) and a grow-only numeric bound (google_compute_disk.size, bounds.growOnly).

operations.title: Change a compute instance's machine type
operations.description: Change the machine_type argument to an allowlisted value. Applied in place; GCP stops and restarts the instance to move it onto the new machine type.

params.name: instance
params.label: Compute instance
params.help: Select the instance to resize; the picker only lists instances already tracked in inventory.

params.name: machine_type
params.label: New machine type
params.help: The GCP machine type that fixes the host's vCPU and memory.

operations.title: Grow a persistent disk
operations.description: Increase a persistent disk's size via the size argument. Grow-only — a GCP persistent disk cannot be shrunk, so this is irreversible.

params.name: disk
params.label: Persistent disk
params.help: Select the persistent disk to enlarge; the size field separately enforces grow-only.

params.name: size
params.label: New size (GiB)
params.help: Must exceed the current size in GiB; a persistent disk cannot be shrunk.
